justification: Nested/local shadowing must not resolve a call to an outer module symbol. Go reports conservative dynamic references with evidence for shadowed local-variable calls; scope nesting is respected by abstention (no resolved outer target).

cases.name: helper
cases.note: Call inside nested block uses nested local shadow; must not resolve to module-level helper

cases.note: Call in outer function uses function-local shadow; must not resolve to module-level helper
